title: PlayStation Offers $40 Off PS5 Refurb Bundles Ahead of GTA 6
description: PlayStation is offering a $40 discount on refurbished PS5 console and DualSense controller bundles ahead of GTA 6, yielding up to $155 in total savings.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Preparing for GTA 6: PlayStation Offers Discounts on Refurbished PS5 Bundles

As anticipation continues to build across the gaming community for the upcoming release of *GTA 6*, players are increasingly looking at hardware upgrades to ensure they are ready for next-gen gaming. According to a recent report by IGN, PlayStation is stepping up with a new hardware promotion designed to make system upgrades more accessible.

PlayStation is currently offering **$40 off** when customers purchase a **refurbished PS5 console** and a **DualSense wireless controller** together as a bundle. This promotional offer delivers up to **$155 in total savings** for buyers looking to secure their hardware setup.

### Hardware Upgrades for Next-Gen Gaming

With *GTA 6* poised to be the defining release of the generation, ensuring your gaming setup meets the demands of modern titles is crucial. For players still holding onto older systems, official refurbished hardware offers a reliable and cost-effective pathway into the current console generation. Official refurbishments typically undergo rigorous testing and include standard guarantees, balancing performance reliability with consumer value.

### Editor's Take

This promotional push from PlayStation cleverly capitalizes on the massive cultural momentum surrounding *GTA 6*. By discounting refurbished bundles by $40 and offering up to $155 in total savings, Sony is effectively lowering the barrier to entry for budget-conscious gamers preparing for the biggest title of the decade. It's a smart hardware strategy ahead of a massive software launch.
